records.page_title: How much does a project cost? Pricing and budget
records.introduction: ZuiGO does not publish project prices or a price list on its website, so the cost of a project cannot be confirmed from the website. The Contact page has an optional budget-range field with choices such as Under $25,000, $25,000 – $50,000, $50,000 – $100,000, $100,000+ and Not sure yet. These are choices a visitor makes to describe their own budget; they are not ZuiGO's prices. To get a realistic scope and estimate, contact ZuiGO at hello@zuigo.ai or book a 30-minute call.
records.provenance: Project-provided guidance based on the saved Contact page; the website does not publish prices.
